solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Taking part in film attack

definitions.meaning: an actor working on a film is said to be ..., at the place where it is shot
a noun for an assault, as in the first rush of an offensive

explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it is the actor's phrase for being at the shoot; as one word it is a noun for an assault or beginning.

clue.text: Expecting the best work, time being short is initially tough in charge

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work

indicators.note: time falls short of its full length, so it loses its last letter

parts.note: the word time itself, before cutting

indicators.note: only the opening letter of tough is used

explanation.surface: A hopeful worker, short of time, finds that being in charge is tough at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being short' trims TIME to TIM; 'initially' takes T from 'tough'.
explanation.definitionFit: A hopeful outlook is one that expects things to turn out well.

clue.text: Music and reels creating metallic element

indicators.note: to reel is to spin or stagger, so the letters whirl into a new order

explanation.surface: Music and dances combine into something shiny.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reels' looks like Scottish dances but rearranges MUSIC AND.
explanation.definitionFit: Element 21 is a silvery metal, a transition element.

clue.text: Number requiring equipment — King put out feeler

parts.note: ten is a number

indicators.note: the king is ejected, so his letter is removed

parts.note: tackle is gear or equipment, as fishing tackle
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A number needs gear once the King has been expelled.
explanation.definitionFit: An octopus arm used for touching and grasping is a feeler.

clue.text: Lady allowed to go round public house for something to read

indicators.note: the lady and the allowed word together are said to circle the pub, so they enclose it

parts.note: Pam is a woman's name, short for Pamela
to let is to allow
PH is the map abbreviation for public house, a British pub

explanation.surface: A woman is permitted to wander round the pub looking for some reading matter.
explanation.definitionFit: A leaflet or booklet is a small printed item meant for reading.

clue.text: Servant partly makes up a geisha

indicators.note: only part of the run of words is used, letters spanning their join

explanation.surface: A servant does some of a Japanese entertainer's make-up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'partly' takes a run of letters from 'up a geisha'; 'makes' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A boy attendant serving a knight or in a hotel is a servant.

clue.text: Pair hold strong affection for bird

indicators.note: the pair hold the affection between them, so they surround it

parts.note: love is strong affection

explanation.surface: A couple are smitten with a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A wading shorebird of the open fields, such as the lapwing, is a bird.

clue.text: Seed found in inlet, sprouting beside lake

indicators.note: the lake's letter is placed next to the rearranged letters
the letters grow out into a new shape, as a seed sprouts

parts.note: L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A seed is discovered germinating in a creek near a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: The edible pulse is the dried seed of a leguminous plant.

clue.text: Drop rent

definitions.meaning: a drop of liquid from the eye, said with an ee sound
a rent is a rip in cloth, said with an air sound

explanation.definitionFit: Spelled the same, one word names a droplet of weeping and the other a split or rip.

clue.text: Ranting about embracing independent education

indicators.note: the rearranged letters hold another piece in their arms, so they surround it
about signals the word ranting is turned around and rearranged

parts.note: I is the standard abbreviation for independent, as on ballot papers

explanation.surface: Someone holds forth angrily about private schooling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges RANTING into TRANNG, and 'embracing' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Instruction that teaches a skill is a form of education, the two used as near synonyms.

clue.text: Lift across the Atlantic

parts.note: a lift as it is called on the other side of the ocean, in American usage

explanation.definitionFit: Americans name the passenger car that carries people between floors by this word where Britons say lift.

clue.text: Colin, a GI, corrected one with sound reasoning

indicators.note: the letters are put right, set in a new order

explanation.surface: Colin puts a soldier straight, showing clear thinking.
explanation.definitionFit: An expert in logic is someone who reasons rigorously and soundly.

clue.text: Without delay I'm going to arbitrate

indicators.note: the letters of I'm are going away, so they are removed from the longer word

parts.note: done without delay is done immediately

explanation.surface: Someone eager to settle a dispute announces they are heading off to do it at once.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I'm going' strips the first two letters from the synonym of 'Without delay'.
explanation.definitionFit: To arbitrate is to step between disputing parties and settle their quarrel, the same as to intervene as a go-between.

clue.text: Latticework that is seen in restrung pearls

indicators.note: the abbreviation appears inside the rearranged letters
pearls restrung are threaded in a new order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: ie, id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A trellis pattern appears in a newly threaded necklace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'restrung' makes ESPALR; 'pearls' suggests jewellery, but the definition is a gardening trellis.
explanation.definitionFit: A trellis on which fruit trees are trained flat is a framework of latticework.

clue.text: Tchaikovsky's sweetie?

parts.note: a sweet from Tchaikovsky's ballet The Nutcracker, whose fairy is named after a boiled confection, not a sweetheart

explanation.definitionFit: This is a small round boiled sweet, and the Nutcracker ballet has a Fairy named after it.

clue.text: Sex act thrown in for criminal

parts.note: male is one of the two sexes

indicators.note: act is thrown into the middle of for

explanation.surface: A sex act thrown in gets someone branded an offender.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrongdoer or evildoer is a criminal, the formal word for one.

clue.text: Where a Victorian could stay dry?

definitions.text: Where a Victorian could stay dry?

parts.words: Where a Victorian could stay dry?
parts.note: dry means teetotal here, not out of the rain: lodgings for abstainers from alcohol in the nineteenth century

explanation.definitionFit: Such establishments served no alcohol, catering to Victorian abstainers who had taken the pledge.

clue.text: Spell above a weight is shown in figure

indicators.note: in a down clue, the spell sits above the rest

parts.note: a hex is a spell or curse
a gram is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: A charm cast over a scale weight shows in a diagram.
explanation.definitionFit: A six-pointed star is a geometric figure.

clue.text: Government department rebuilt at Surrey

indicators.note: the letters are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: A ministry is reconstructed in a home county.
explanation.walkthrough: SURREY is a county south of London.
explanation.definitionFit: The ministry managing public finance in Britain and the US is a government department.

clue.text: One sharing top billing starts to irritate customers around country

parts.note: a co-star shares the leading credit with another actor

indicators.note: the opening letters of the next three words are taken in turn

explanation.surface: A billed actor's arrival begins to annoy the clientele somewhere abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: A Central American republic between Nicaragua and Panama is a country.

clue.text: Superior and I may be taken in by Spanish man

indicators.note: the I is drawn into the Spanish gentleman's title

parts.note: señor is Spanish for a man or mister

explanation.surface: A superior and I could be fooled by a Spaniard.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone higher in rank is one's superior, an older or higher-ranking person.

clue.text: A spring swarm

parts.note: to bound is to spring or leap

explanation.surface: A leap of a crowd of bees.
explanation.definitionFit: To abound with, or swarm with, is to be present in great numbers.

clue.text: Falls back in with commander and artist

indicators.note: the little word in is turned back to front

parts.note: an aga is a Turkish military commander
RA is a Royal Academician, a member of the Royal Academy of Arts

explanation.surface: Someone falls back into line with an officer and a painter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns IN into NI; 'Falls' looks like a verb but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous waterfalls on the US-Canada border are known simply as the Falls.

clue.text: Do ration ingredients for cooking

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are the raw material mixed into something new

explanation.surface: An instruction to share out the components of a recipe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ingredients' rearranges DO RATION; the definition is adjectival, describing a style used in cooking.
explanation.definitionFit: This names an Indian clay-oven method, used to describe food prepared in that way of cooking.

clue.text: Ride for a fall?

definitions.meaning: a ride is a journey or excursion
to stumble over something is what brings on a fall

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a journey or outing, and also to stumble, causing a fall.

clue.text: Man sounds promising

indicators.note: the clue signals a word said out loud

parts.note: I'll is a promise, I will

explanation.surface: A man sounds hopeful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' is the Isle of Man in the Irish Sea, not a person.
explanation.definitionFit: The Isle of Man is an island, so Man names one.

clue.text: Magical quality that's captured by astronaut in vacuum?

definitions.text: Magical quality that's captured by astronaut in vacuum?

parts.words: Magical quality that's captured by astronaut in vacuum?
parts.note: a dreamy charm, pictured as the space grit a spacefarer could gather in the vacuum of space or with a vacuum cleaner

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a romantic, glamorous aura, and literally the fine particles of the cosmos.

clue.text: March round island in state of bliss

indicators.note: the march goes round the island, enclosing it

parts.note: a parade is a procession or march

explanation.surface: A procession circles an island in a mood of great happiness.
explanation.definitionFit: Heaven or Eden stands for a state of perfect happiness.

clue.text: Local leader finds gold after 31 days

indicators.note: the gold comes after the month, so it follows in the answer

parts.note: May is a month of thirty-one days
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A town chief strikes it rich at the end of a month.
explanation.definitionFit: A town or city council is headed by this civic official.
